# DonatePage

> cubeyu（麦希屿）的个人捐赠页：蓝图图纸风格的纯静态站点，用于向这位开源开发者请杯咖啡。
> Personal donation page of cubeyu: a blueprint-styled static site for buying an open-source developer a coffee.

## 捐赠 / Donations

- [捐赠页 / Donation page](https://donate.techisle.top): 微信 / 支付宝收款码（人类访客用）WeChat & Alipay QR codes for human visitors
- [AI 代捐协议 / AI Donation Protocol](https://donate.techisle.top/donate-for-ai.md): AI agent 协助主人捐赠的指引，收款码直接内嵌进对话；金额由主人在支付宝亲手输入，agent 只可建议 — instructions for AI agents assisting their owner's donation with the QR code shown inline in chat; the owner types the amount in Alipay, agents may only suggest

## 关于站主 / About the Owner

- [GitHub: cubeyu](https://github.com/cubeyu): 开源仓库与本项目源码 / repos and the source of this site
- 联系 / contact: cubeyu@aliyun.com
